Use `snl macro-package export` to produce a portable export of one Macro Package after it validates.

### Command path
`macro-package/export` is the canonical transport-neutral command. The shell adapter is `snl macro-package export`; an Agent/MCP adapter submits the same operation object instead of reconstructing shell text.

### Operation request
```json
{"protocol":"snl.operation/v1","command":"macro-package/export","root":"/absolute/workspace","arguments":{"id":"<exact-id>","format":"json","output":"-"}}
```
Every adapter accepts exactly this semantic request. Unknown argument keys are rejected. The CLI accepts `--root` and `--json` globally and emits one complete JSON document followed by a newline. Export closure includes required referenced metadata; unsupported/lossy formats fail closed.

### Success result
A successful call exits `0` and returns `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":true,"command":"macro-package/export","data":...,"diagnostics":[]}`. `data` contains or identifies a deterministic self-describing export and its digest.

### Failure and exit semantics
Domain rejection (invalid data, not-found, conflict, or validation errors) exits `1`. Invocation, input I/O, unsupported workspace/schema, lock acquisition, and runtime failures exit `2`. Failure stdout under `--json` is exactly one `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":false,"command":"macro-package/export","error":{"code":"<stable-code>","message":"<actionable text>","details":...,"retryable":false}}`; no stack trace or prose contaminates stdout.

### State and concurrency
Read-only with respect to the workspace. Explicit output-file writes must be exclusive/atomic and never modify `.SNL_Doc`. Revisions, cursors, checked digests, and workspace revisions are opaque tokens. Repeated calls against unchanged bytes return equivalent semantic results.
